query: SELECT count(*) AS "total!: i64" FROM alerts WHERE (json_array_length(?1) = 0 OR status IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))) AND (json_array_length(?2) = 0 OR severity IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?2))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?3) AS name JOIN json_each(?4) AS expected ON expected.key = name.key JOIN json_each(?5) AS equal ON equal.key = name.key WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(alerts.labels, '$."' || name.value || '"'), '') = expected.value) <> equal.value) AND (?6 IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications WHERE notifications.dedupe_key = 'a:' || alerts.fingerprint AND notifications.state = ?6))
